name: Auto Deco
description: Generate full level decoration (glow, ground deco, hanging deco, background and air particles) in one click.

max-objects.name: Max objects per generation
max-objects.description: Safety cap so a huge level doesn't freeze the editor.

gen-group.name: Generated group ID
gen-group.description: Every generated object is put in this group so 'Clear generated' can find and remove it. Pick a group your level doesn't use.

glow-ids.name: Glow object IDs
glow-ids.description: Comma-separated IDs placed along exposed block edges. Use the 'Grab' button in the generator to fill this from selected objects.

top-ids.name: Ground/top deco IDs
top-ids.description: Placed on top of block surfaces (grass, spikes deco, etc).

bg-ids.name: Background deco IDs
bg-ids.description: Placed behind blocks on a background Z layer.

air-ids.name: Air particle IDs
air-ids.description: Scattered in empty space above the level.
